[ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 21 dachshund mixes rescued from hoarding situation in Pasco County
item.description: The Humane Society was caring for 21 dachshund mixes rescued from a hoarding situation. Pinellas County government officials say an owner surrendered the animals to Pinellas County Animal Services last week.
